cases.name: Jordan Wheeler
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Jordan was a devoted mother, daughter, sister, granddaughter, aunt and friend who gave selflessly to those who were fortunate to have known her. Jordan was a mom first above all else. She loved being a mom and her children were everything to her. She was always happy to watch over her nieces and nephews too, available to babysit almost any time and had patience that was unmatched by others. Time spent with her family was most important. She also loved her coffee, particularly Starbucks and enjoyed an occasional margarita. A beautiful person, she will be deeply missed by her family and friends."
cases.narrative: She called 911 and asked police to come because her husband was assaulting her. While she was on the phone, Wheeler allegedly shot her multiple times, killing her.
